author: liam.oconnor - Sports Editor
title: Force Home Games | Super Rugby Pacific 2026 Fixture
text:
Western Force Unveils 2026 Super Rugby Pacific Fixture, Pioneering Joondalup Match & Streamlining Travel The Western Force have announced thier schedule for the 2026 Super Rugby Pacific season, highlighted by seven Saturday home games and a considerably improved travel plan designed to minimize player fatigue. The fixture, confirmed on Thursday, marks a new era for the club, including a historic first – a match at Arena Joondalup’s HIF Health Insurance Oval in Round 2.
The Western Australian club will welcome all three other Australian Super Rugby teams,as well as the Fijian drua (Round 15) and New Zealand’s Blues (Round 2 at Joondalup),Chiefs (Round 7),and Crusaders (Round 10).This diverse schedule promises a compelling mix of local rivalries and international challenges for the team and its supporters.
A key focus for the 2026 season is reducing the ample travel burden faced by the team in recent years. Last season, the Force logged over 50,000 kilometers in travel. To address this, the new fixture includes a concentrated three-game road trip to New Zealand from Rounds 3-5, alongside strategically placed two-game away trips, one of which is buffered by a bye week.
“From a high performance perspective, we’re really happy with our 2026 fixture,” stated a senior official with the club. “We see major benefits in having three road trips through the season, playing away games in blocks to ease the travel burden for our players.”
The Force will not undertake any overseas travel after their Round 9 match against the Fijian Drua, and all three new Zealand away games will be played consecutively. the team will also benefit from bye weeks in Rounds 6 and 11 throughout the 16-round season.
All seven home games are scheduled for Saturdays, with kick-off times varying to accommodate fan preferences. Three games will begin at 4:35pm, three at 5:35pm – adjusted for the end of daylight savings time – and the highly anticipated clash against the Crusaders in Round 10 will commence at 7:55pm.
Force CEO Niamh O’Connor emphasized the importance of home-field advantage,stating,”We’re delighted to host seven home games in front of our sea of Blue including taking one game into the community at Joondalup for the first time. Our fan feedback shows that the late Saturday afternoon and evening kick-off times suit our Members and supporters and we really need them to make our home ground a fortress as we chase finals in 2026.”
Head coach Simon Cron echoed the sentiment regarding the improved travel schedule,noting that “blocking travel rather than zig zagging” will significantly benefit player recovery and training intensity. “Now it is indeed blocked this will help us keep training load and intensity closer to our required level each week as recovery will be less compromised,” he explained.
The 2026 season will also hold special meaning as it marks almost 20 years to the day as the Force’s inaugural Super Rugby clash against the Brumbies at Subiaco Oval in 2006, a match attended by 37,000 fans. The team will further extend its reach by taking Super Rugby to the community with the Round 2 match against the blues at arena Joondalup. [Click here for Arena Joondalup Membership FAQs].
Following the New Zealand leg, the Force will face the Chiefs at HBF Park in Round 7 before embarking on away games against the Queensland Reds and the fijian Drua.After a bye during Super Round in Christchurch,the team will conclude the regular season with home matches against the Reds,Drua,and Waratahs in May,all kicking off at 5:35pm.
Force Memberships will be available for purchase in October at westernforce.rugby, starting at $129 for adults – equivalent to $21.50 per game. Renewals for 2025 Club Members will be offered one week prior to the general sale. Fans can catch every game of the 2026 Super Rugby Pacific season live on Stan Sport, with select matches also broadcast on Channel Nine. Fans are encouraged to register their interest in a 2026 Western Force Membership to be among the first to know when tickets go on sale.
